**Access boundary:** Restricted operator authority required.

API 1.1.22 and migrations 0068–0070 were deployed on 31 October; legacy triggered/resolved email receipt did not establish business recovery. PR131 merged the 1.1.23 narrow Pingen lineage and forbidden-fax compatibility fixes as afedd099081099fa83bf6bd9edaf6dcabacbea03, published on 1 November with expected active-postal/inactive-fax bindings observed and no pending/unknown business sends. The 1.1.24 server markers and final saved Automatic/300-second native monitor were deployed and verified on 1 November; prior native JSON/depth validation attempts saved no replacement. An existing-counter probe validated the shallow aggregate type with missing-row literal 1.0; later runtime publication and final saved configuration were separately verified, while genuine provider renewals and delivery retain distinct qualification. Production 1.1.26 contains the alert/reference corrections and the separately authorized Full-access Resend source inspection now passes; genuine scheduled renewal and incident recovery still await the 11:37 UTC Cron evidence at this handoff. Runtime/schema, private inspection, renewal, notification receipt and real delivery remain separate evidence. Unpublished 1.1.27 adds independent short-lived worldwide postal destination checks without changing those maintenance rights.

**Surfaces:** Existing private scheduled maintenance, provider-inspection RPC/operator CLI, GitHub scanner watchdog and separately authorized native-monitor configuration; no public browser, REST or MCP maintenance surface.
